confidence_basis: Labels by two team members on the image the rule reads; no ground check.
what_this_is: How often the THEOS-2 water rule says what team members say who look at the same image at full detail, on 300 points drawn at random in six groups. Agreement between a rule and its readers; no ground check.
scoring_label: The label at least two of the three gave, where it is water or not water (plan section 6, amended on 12 October before any figure was computed). Other points are left out of figures a to d and counted. Beside it: all three agreeing, each pair agreeing as the plan first had it, and each labeller alone.
estimator: Stratified random sample with the six groups of each chip as strata (Stehman 2014); 95 percent intervals by the normal approximation; counts of one group with a Wilson interval. Points left out are taken to be missing at random inside their group.

two_rules.what_this_is: Rule v1 and the second rule, frozen before any label file was opened, on the same 300 points. The share answered and alike counts area a rule sets aside as not alike.
sentences: On the two reference chips together, rule v1 gives an answer that is the label on 69% (65% to 74%) of the area with a scoring label, and the second rule on 78% (72% to 83%).
On the chip without a flood, rule v1 calls 23% of the chip water and the second rule 0%; by the labels 1% (0% to 4%) of it is water.
The second rule is better on these points by 8 points (4 to 13).
The test points lie on the three images the second rule was developed on; no earlier figure is replaced.

Callixta, Putu and Rachmania each labelled 300 points on three THEOS-2 chips. On the two chips that served as a reference at least two of the three gave the same label of water or not water on 216 of 240 points. On those, 90% (83% to 96%) of the area the rule calls water is water to at least two of the three, and the rule finds 71% (64% to 77%) of the water they see.
All labellers gave the same label on 57% of all points; Cohen's kappa by pair: Callixta and Putu 0.4679, Callixta and Rachmania 0.4083, Putu and Rachmania 0.5283.
On the chip that was set aside because it holds no flood, 5% (0% to 16%) of the area the rule calls water is water to at least two of the three (59 of 60 points scored).
Every figure is agreement between a rule and readers of the same image; nobody went to the ground, and no radar figure is changed with them.
plan_section_7.consequence: The documents and the pitch do not call the THEOS-2 water a reference without the figure in the same sentence.

limits: The labels come from the same image the rule reads, in true and false colour: the figures say whether the rule reads the image as a person does, not what was on the ground.
The labellers are team members, not trained image interpreters.
Three chips of two days in one season and one region; none of them covers Mae Sai.
A square of 2 m at the edge of water is often mixed; 'more than half' is a judgement.
